name: Thaumaturgy
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0, cleric/oracle 0, medium 1, occultist 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Target special
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You may manifest some power to show some sign of supernatural power. You can create one of the following effects within the range:

Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal.
You can cause flames or other lights to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color.
You can cause harmless tremors or vibrations.
You can create a harmless but ominous sound like a thunder crash, battle horn or ominous chanting.
Alter the appearance or color of your eyes and hair.
